title: Free tutorial: Read one phishing header
summary: Read who really sent an email, what SPF, DKIM and DMARC said, and where the link really goes.

next.title: Seminar 3: SOC triage: alerts, phishing, threat intel and AI verdicts

script.intro: Welcome. Five emails were reported. For each one you decide: phishing, payment fraud, spam or genuine, and you prove it from the headers.
script.outro: Verdict plus evidence is a triage note. Seminar 3 turns this into a full phishing and alert-triage routine.
steps: Read the setting so you know the company, the date and the time zone. Then open the evidence in the case folder.

For every email, read who really sent it: the Return-Path and the Received line, not the display name. Read what SPF, DKIM and DMARC said. Hover the link to see where it really goes. In password-expiry the link text shows the company sign-in address, but the href goes somewhere else. In bank-details the display name says CFO, the address is a free mail account, and SPF, DKIM and DMARC all pass for that free mail domain, because passing only proves the free mail service sent it. Name the pressure tactics too: urgency, authority, secrecy. Then write the verdict.
